title: Blades in the Dark / Forged in the Dark
author: ThunderForgeVTT Contributors
description: Blades in the Dark / Forged in the Dark ruleset for ThunderForgeVTT, digested from its official SRD (see research/system_blades_in_the_dark.json for full provenance).

actionRoll.description: Blades in the Dark action/resistance/fortune roll: roll a pool of d6s equal to the relevant action rating (bound via the `rating` placeholder) and take the single highest die. Special case not expressible in one formula string: a rating of 0 instead rolls 2d6 and takes the LOWEST die (application logic should send a fixed "2d6kl1" formula when the rating is 0, rather than binding `rating` to 0).

legal.requiredUiPlacement: Must be shown on the system selection screen when a GM picks Blades in the Dark / Forged in the Dark, and/or a permanent, easily accessible module settings tab for the system — not buried in a ToS or changelog.
